profiles.name: Smythson
profiles.why: Papier's own copy frames the ability to personalise the diary title itself as unique (E12), while Smythson's FAQ describes its personalisation service as covering initials, names, dates, or a selection of motifs stamped on notebook covers. Both companies make personalisation central to the premium stationery buying decision, but only Papier's page claims title-level customisation as a distinguishing feature; this does not establish Smythson lacks it, only that its own description does not mention it.
profiles.discovery_reason: The long-established premium London stationer a buyer checks against before deciding if Papier's personalised notebooks and diaries are the right quality tier, since Papier itself is positioned as the gap between Smythson and mass-market players.
profiles.one_liner: From daily to-dos and scribbles to the blueprints of a grand project, document every thought within our handcrafted leather notebook collection.
profiles.promise: Meticulously bound in England and filled with our signature blue Featherweight pages, our notebooks are available in an extensive range of sizes and colours.
profiles.pricing: Per-product pricing on individual notebooks and diaries, no subscription; prices vary by collection, material and collaboration, e.g. $125 (Smythson x Aston Martin Aramco F1® Team Panama Notebook), $195 (2027 Chelsea Weekly Journal in Panama), $295 (Soho Notebook in Metallic Leather / 2027 Soho Weekly Diary in Panama), $325 (Burberry x Smythson Soho Notebook in Panama), $375 (2027 Soho Weekly Journal in Panama, Ludlow variants), $475 (Smythson x Aston Martin Aramco F1® Team Soho Circuit Journal); complimentary delivery, duties and taxes included, on orders over $500.
profiles.free_entry: No free tier, trial or demo described on these pages; this is physical retail with per-item purchase only.
